package.name: wamoduck_description
package.description:
URDF description of the Wamoduck (wmduck) 15-DoF biped, for robot_state_publisher + RViz.
IMPORTANT -- no asset is stored twice in this repository. The canonical model lives at models/wmduck/ (wmduck.urdf plus 20 binary STL meshes, ~11 MB). This package does not copy them. At build time CMake
1. rewrites the canonical URDF's mesh references from the file-relative form "meshes/X.stl" to "package://wamoduck_description/meshes/X.stl" (RViz resolves meshes through resource_retriever, which cannot use a URDF-relative path), and 2. installs the meshes straight out of models/wmduck/meshes into the package share directory.
So models/wmduck/ stays the single source of truth for geometry, and the meshes exist exactly once inside the Git repository. See urdf/README.md and the top-level ros2/README.md for the mechanism, its consequences, and how to override the source directory on a different machine (e.g. the RDK X5).
